title: SVEA-Pommern: Maps and texts of the Swedish land survey of Pomerania north of the Peene (1692-1709)
institution: Universität Greifswald (Geographisches Institut) with the Landesarchiv Greifswald and Universität Rostock (Stefan Kroll)
notes: Edition of the Swedish land survey (Landesaufnahme) of Pomerania north of the river Peene, the first cadastre of its kind in Germany: descriptions of villages and estates in older Swedish, with a transcription (HTML) and German translation (HTML and XML) for each of 255 places, a web map and indexes. The main survey is dated 1692-1698 (our check: 1694, 1696 and 1697 are the usual dates); a revision of 1704-1709 is transcribed in the same pages, so part of each text falls after 1700. Most pages give both the original fair copy and the draft. The in-period share of the words could not be separated reliably, so no word count is given; the transcription pages hold roughly 600,000 tokens in all. The project is described as finished and the site was last edited on 3 March 2025. The Greifswald and Rostock copyright notice allows research, teaching and private use.
